title: Capture every idea the moment it occurs, always.
subtitle: Always-on notebook
rationale: Working memory drops ideas within minutes; a capture tool always in reach preserves them and frees attention.

evidence.summary: Da Vinci's belt notebook through GTD; working-memory decay is well established, the capture habit itself is practitioner canon.

sources.label: David Senra on daily study blocks

indications: Good ideas from walks and showers are gone by the desk.
Open loops circulate in the head instead of a system.
